messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

### Chain map
The supported chain is: Wireless Communication market driver → measurable test parameter → required Signal Generator and/or Signal Analyzer capability, using solution mappings and product/test passages from the knowledge base [3][1].
| Wireless Communication market requirement | Measurable parameter / test need | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming are listed as industry drivers, and MIMO is described as using many antennas to increase capacity while beamforming increases antenna gain/system efficiency, especially at mmWave [3][16]. | The measurement need is MIMO generation and analysis, 5G NR multi-channel analysis, and integrated fading simulation [16]. | R&S SMW200A can expand to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to 8 signal sources and 64 fading channels, can connect SGT100A modules for up to 8 RF paths, and supports MIMO fading scenarios such as 2x2, 4x4, 8x4, and 4x8 [4]. | The cited analyzer-side capability for this chain is R&S VSE 5G MIMO analysis software linked to 5G NR multi-channel analysis [16]. |
| OTA testing and base-station conformance are listed as industry drivers / solution areas, and higher frequencies plus Massive MIMO make conducted testing impractical so OTA testing becomes necessary [3][16][1]. | OTA transmitter metrics include EIRP, TRP, transmitter OFF power, frequency error, EVM, TAE, OBW, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, and intermodulation [89]. | Signal generator capability includes built-in presets and 5G NR Test Case Wizard for 3GPP TS 38.141-2 context, and SMW200A or SMBV100B with K144 can generate the interfering signal for intermodulation testing [18][31]. | Analyzer capability includes FSW / FSV / FSVA / FSV3000 / FSVA3000 / FPS with 5G NR downlink measurements option K144, and FSW-K544 is used for OTA calibration with SMW-K544 [31][32]. |
| More spectrum bands, higher frequencies, and expanding bandwidth are listed as an industry driver and mapped to high-frequency/mmWave/early-6G solutions including SMW200A and FSW [3][1]. | The measurable needs are frequency range, RF modulation bandwidth, and analysis bandwidth [6][7][51]. | R&S SMW200A RF path A can cover 100 kHz to 67 GHz with 67 GHz to 72 GHz overrange, and its RF modulation bandwidth can reach 2 GHz under the stated wideband baseband condition [6]. | R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz, and FSW analysis bandwidth options go up to 8.312 GHz [7][51]. |
| 5G NTN-NR is described as gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industries, with initial S/L-band transparent-payload focus and later extension toward regenerative architecture and Ka/K/Ku/Q/V bands [11]. | NTN channel-emulation parameters include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [11][12]. | R&S SMW200A channel-emulation capability for NTN includes firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, K820 customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, and enhanced Doppler [12][13]. | R&S FSW / FSWX support satellite payload testing metrics including EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [21]. |
| 5G NR SAN conformance testing is tied to Satellite Access Node testing under 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181, with SMW200A as the core signal generator / channel emulator [75]. | SAN / base-station-in-the-sky testing focuses on output power, power dynamics, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR, OBUE, receiver sensitivity, blocking, and PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance [70]. | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO / MIMO, NR K144 / K148 / K171, and B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation [77]. | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter measurements need a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on FSW / FSVA support those Chapter 6 and 9 measurements [24]. |
| Energy efficiency / network energy saving is listed as an industry driver [3]. | The measurable needs include optimization of power consumption, power statistics over time, device activity versus power consumption, real-time power / voltage / current statistics, and measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers [64]. | The signal-generator-side capability is a VSG + software turnkey solution with real-time envelope signal generation for an envelope tracker, including SMW-K546 [64]. | The analyzer-side capability is a VSA + software turnkey solution with dedicated software applications for Doherty, including FSW-K18 [64]. |
### Limits
These mappings are solution- and application-level chains, not a formal quote configuration, datasheet replacement, or standards compliance statement [43].  
The passages warn that claims such as full 38.141 support need formal standards, datasheets, application notes, or certification records to confirm complete test-case matrices, options, releases, calibration accessories, and compliance status [17][43].

passages.text:
Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › Solution mapping 摘要
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]：

- [[Beamforming]] / [[Massive MIMO]]：[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S NRQ6]]、[[R&S NRPM]]、[[R&S ZNBT]]。
- [[OTA testing]] / base station conformance：[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S PWC200]]、5G NR Test Case Wizard、[[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]。
- Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G：[[R&S SMA100B]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]]、mmWave front ends / frequency converters。
- Digital design & power：[[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Network energy saving：[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07、RT-ZC31、[[R&S SMW-K546]]、[[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- [[O-RU testing]]：[[O-RAN test manager]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、O-RU tester C/U/S/M planes、[[R&S SMW200A]] / [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]、[[R&S RTO6]]。
- Network densification / small cells：[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSV]]、[[R&S FE44A]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、Wireless Manufacturing Test（WMT）。

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › unresolved
- 需要回查原 PPTX 圖片與 speaker notes，以確認產品連線、圖中箭頭、license / option 與測試流程。
- [[O-RAN Alliance WG4 Conformance Specifications]]、[[ETSI ES 202 706-1]]、[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 的版本未標示。
- [[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S NRPM]]、[[R&S ZNBT]]、[[R&S NGP800]] 等產品仍需 formal product sources 補強。

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › Industry drivers
來源列出的 industry drivers 包含：

| Driver | 來源語彙 | 對應知識頁 |
|---|---|---|
| MIMO / Beamforming | Increasing MIMO Degrees & Beamforming | [[Beamforming]]、[[Massive MIMO]]、[[MIMO]] |
| OTA | Over-The-Air | [[OTA testing]]、[[5G NR Base Station Conformance Testing]] |
| Spectrum / frequency | More Spectrum Bands / Higher Frequencies / Expanding Bandwidth | [[More Spectrum Bands and Higher Frequencies]]、[[Early 6G RF testing]] |
| Digital / power | Digital Design & Power | [[Digital Design & Power]]、[[Power Integrity]] |
| Energy | Energy Efficiency / Network energy saving | [[Network energy saving]] |
| Densification | Network Densification | [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]]、[[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] |
| Economic efficiency | Cost Efficiency / Flexibility | [[HUMS]]、[[Floating Licensing Models]] |
| Private networks | Private Networks | [[Private Networks]] |
| Open RAN | Disaggregation & Virtualization / Towards Open RAN based networks | [[O-RU testing]] |

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。

- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |

| 6.5.4 | Time alignment error（TAE） | 多個 NR signals 之間最大 timing difference。 |

| 6.6.4 | Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM） | Operating band unwanted emissions / spectrum emission mask。 |

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.6 Receiver Spurious Emissions
- Spurious emissions power 是 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。
- 測試需在 Tx 與 Rx 均開啟時執行，Tx port terminated。
- Receiver spurious emission limits 適用頻率範圍為 30 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；若 UL operating band upper frequency edge 的 5th harmonic 超過 12.75 GHz，範圍會延伸。
- Receiver spurious emission requirements：30 MHz–1 GHz 最大 -57.0 dBm、100 kHz measurement bandwidth；1 GHz–12.75 GHz 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth；12.75 GHz–5th harmonic 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth。
- Test setup：base station 依 TM1.1 以 rated output power 傳送 NR signal；FSW 透過 Tx notch filter 測量 Rx emissions；Tx 與其他 Rx ports terminated。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.7 Receiver Intermodulation
- Intermodulation response rejection 衡量 receiver 在 two interfering signals 存在下於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Interfering signals 是 CW signal 與 QPSK modulation 的 NR signal。
- NR interferer 在 baseband B 產生；CW interferer 可由 SMW second RF path 的 `AWGN B` block 產生，或由 external signal generator 產生，例如 [[R&S SGS100A]] 或 [[R&S SMA100B]]。
- General intermodulation interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Narrow-band intermodulation interferer levels 同樣為 Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC77`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.8 In-channel selectivity
- ICS 衡量 receiver 在較大 power spectral density 的 interfering signal 存在下，於 assigned resource block locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- 每個 measured NR carrier 的 throughput 應 ≥ possible maximum throughput 的 95%。
- SMW 第二路徑產生 NR interferer。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC78`。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報與 OneNote 轉檔，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、price book 或 3GPP specification。

- 來源中的 R17/18 option wording 不可直接覆寫正式 product option name；正式命名仍以產品規格書為準。

NTN signal generator solutions › SAN testing
來源將 SAN testing 連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]]、[[3GPP TS 38.181]]、[[3GPP TS 36.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.181]]。在 signal generator 角度，[[R&S SMW200A]] 提供：

- Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs）。
- Test Models（TMs）。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT options：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR options：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

詳見 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強 [[Beamforming]]：既有頁面主要是 link hub，本來源提供簡報層級的 beamforming / MIMO / Massive MIMO 定義與測試方案映射。
- 補強 [[5G NR Base Station Conformance Testing]]：來源再次確認 5G NR base station conformance testing 從 conducted 到 OTA 的 R&D 脈絡，並提到 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、test case wizard 與 transmitter / receiver / performance tests。
- 補強 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 與 [[R&S PWC200]]：來源提供 2025 MWC sales / solution view，特別是 PWC200 1.5 m vs 23.5 m 的 far-field / near-field 說法與 ATS1800C 30 cm quiet zone。
- 補強 [[O-RU testing]]：既有頁面只有 link hub，這份來源新增 integrated solution、C/U/S/M planes、O-TMA、VSE、FSW / FSVA3000、SMW200A / SMBV100B、PVT360A、3GPP TS 38.141 / O-RAN WG4 與 ETSI ES 202 706-1 energy efficiency testing 的簡報層級資訊。
- 連接 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 與 [[Network Densification]]：來源把 FWA、mmWave radios、sub-6 small cells、repeaters 視為 densification use cases，但未提供 FWA CPE 標準、型號或測試矩陣。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Network densification、small cells、production 與 private networks
- Slide 25 network densification 包含 FWA for last mile、mmWave radios、sub-6 small cells、repeaters。
- Slide 26 將 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSV]]、[[R&S FE44A]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S RTP]] / [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 等列於 chamber / conformance、small cells、embedded design & power、RF design and compliance 脈絡。
- Slide 27 提出 high-volume testing of mmWave small cells and radio units，產品 / 方案包含 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、Wireless Manufacturing Test（WMT），並宣稱 fully validated in QDART、ultrafast measurement speed、parallel testing of multiple DUTs、supported RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、fully automated path correction concept。
- Slide 28–29 private networks 以 healthcare、industries & manufacturers、transport、enterprises / campus / stadiums、mission critical communications、smart city / neutral hosts 等為應用，強調 site acceptance、data analytics、service monitoring、spectrum clearance & interference hunting。
- Slide 30 將 network infrastructure architecture 分為 antenna、RU / radio unit、BBU / baseband unit 與 mobile network，測試活動包含 design & validation、R&D、conformance、calibration、Rx/Tx tests、go/no-go tests、network measurement / analysis / troubleshooting / monitoring、baseband verification、functional performance、RF parametric、RF component & digital design、baseband algorithm、transmitter / receiver / performance tests。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 `MWC2025---WIC-INFRA.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `Mobile Network Infrastructure — leading T&M solutions for evolving industry trends`，語境為 Mobile World Congress 2025 Barcelona，頁首標示 `COMPANY RESTRICTED`；正式簡報日期除 MWC 2025 語境外未標示，raw converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源把 mobile network infrastructure 的主要 industry drivers 整理為：

- [[Increasing MIMO degrees and Beamforming]] / [[Beamforming]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[More Spectrum Bands and Higher Frequencies]]。
- [[Digital Design & Power]]。
- [[Network energy saving]] / energy efficiency。
- [[Network Densification]]。
- [[Cost Efficiency and Flexibility]]。
- [[Private Networks]]。
- [[Disaggregation and Virtualization]]。
- [[Open RAN]] / [[O-RU testing]]。

簡報以 Rohde & Schwarz 測試量測產品組合對應上述趨勢，包括 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S NRQ6]]、[[R&S NRPM]]、[[R&S ZNBT]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S PWC200]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S CMQ200]] 與多種 mmWave frequency converter / front end。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › O-RAN / O-RU testing
- Slide 22 說 R&S 是 [[3GPP]] 與 [[O-RAN Alliance]] member，並 actively contributing to specification activities。
- Slide 23 提出 fully integrated solution for [[O-RU testing]]，涵蓋 conformance / certification / release / production testing。
- Slide 23 的測試配置包含 [[O-RAN test manager]]（O-TMA）、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、O-RU tester（C/U/S/M planes）、O-RU DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] / [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]，並可選 anechoic chamber for OTA measurements。
- Slide 23 說 integrated test set-up compliant to [[3GPP TS 38.141]] & [[O-RAN Alliance WG4 Conformance Specifications]]。
- Slide 24 針對 O-RU testing 的 energy efficiency testing，列出 [[ETSI ES 202 706-1]]，並搭配 [[R&S RTO6]] oscilloscope 與 power supply。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報，不是正式 3GPP specification 或 R&S configuration guide。
- 來源未標示正式 publication date；只見 12-2025、Last updated 08/25 與部分 workshop date。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › Test Models 與 FRCs
來源 slide 34 / 35 說 Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter characteristics 使用 Test Models（TMs），且 presets already implemented in 5G NR software options K144、K148、K171。表中列出：

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.4.1 Adjacent Channel Selectivity
- ACS 衡量 receiver 在相鄰通道 interfering signal 存在時，於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。

- Wanted level = [[3GPP TS 38.104]] reference sensitivity level + 6 dB。
- ACS NR interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Interferer 是 DFT-s-OFDM signal，QPSK modulation。

### Chain map
The supported chain is: Wireless Communication market driver → measurable test parameter → required Signal Generator and/or Signal Analyzer capability, using solution mappings and product/test passages from the knowledge base [3][1].
| Wireless Communication market requirement | Measurable parameter / test need | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming are listed as industry drivers, and MIMO is described as using many antennas to increase capacity while beamforming increases antenna gain/system efficiency, especially at mmWave [3][16]. | The measurement need is MIMO generation and analysis, 5G NR multi-channel analysis, and integrated fading simulation [16]. | R&S SMW200A can expand to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to 8 signal sources and 64 fading channels, can connect SGT100A modules for up to 8 RF paths, and supports MIMO fading scenarios such as 2x2, 4x4, 8x4, and 4x8 [4]. | The cited analyzer-side capability for this chain is R&S VSE 5G MIMO analysis software linked to 5G NR multi-channel analysis [16]. |
| OTA testing and base-station conformance are listed as industry drivers / solution areas, and higher frequencies plus Massive MIMO make conducted testing impractical so OTA testing becomes necessary [3][16][1]. | OTA transmitter metrics include EIRP, TRP, transmitter OFF power, frequency error, EVM, TAE, OBW, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, and intermodulation [89]. | Signal generator capability includes built-in presets and 5G NR Test Case Wizard for 3GPP TS 38.141-2 context, and SMW200A or SMBV100B with K144 can generate the interfering signal for intermodulation testing [18][31]. | Analyzer capability includes FSW / FSV / FSVA / FSV3000 / FSVA3000 / FPS with 5G NR downlink measurements option K144, and FSW-K544 is used for OTA calibration with SMW-K544 [31][32]. |
| More spectrum bands, higher frequencies, and expanding bandwidth are listed as an industry driver and mapped to high-frequency/mmWave/early-6G solutions including SMW200A and FSW [3][1]. | The measurable needs are frequency range, RF modulation bandwidth, and analysis bandwidth [6][7][51]. | R&S SMW200A RF path A can cover 100 kHz to 67 GHz with 67 GHz to 72 GHz overrange, and its RF modulation bandwidth can reach 2 GHz under the stated wideband baseband condition [6]. | R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz, and FSW analysis bandwidth options go up to 8.312 GHz [7][51]. |
| 5G NTN-NR is described as gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industries, with initial S/L-band transparent-payload focus and later extension toward regenerative architecture and Ka/K/Ku/Q/V bands [11]. | NTN channel-emulation parameters include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler [11][12]. | R&S SMW200A channel-emulation capability for NTN includes firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, K820 customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, and enhanced Doppler [12][13]. | R&S FSW / FSWX support satellite payload testing metrics including EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [21]. |
| 5G NR SAN conformance testing is tied to Satellite Access Node testing under 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181, with SMW200A as the core signal generator / channel emulator [75]. | SAN / base-station-in-the-sky testing focuses on output power, power dynamics, frequency error, modulation quality, ACLR, OBUE, receiver sensitivity, blocking, and PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance [70]. | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, fading module, AWGN module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO / MIMO, NR K144 / K148 / K171, and B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation [77]. | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter measurements need a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on FSW / FSVA support those Chapter 6 and 9 measurements [24]. |
| Energy efficiency / network energy saving is listed as an industry driver [3]. | The measurable needs include optimization of power consumption, power statistics over time, device activity versus power consumption, real-time power / voltage / current statistics, and measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers [64]. | The signal-generator-side capability is a VSG + software turnkey solution with real-time envelope signal generation for an envelope tracker, including SMW-K546 [64]. | The analyzer-side capability is a VSA + software turnkey solution with dedicated software applications for Doherty, including FSW-K18 [64]. |
### Limits
These mappings are solution- and application-level chains, not a formal quote configuration, datasheet replacement, or standards compliance statement [43].  
The passages warn that claims such as full 38.141 support need formal standards, datasheets, application notes, or certification records to confirm complete test-case matrices, options, releases, calibration accessories, and compliance status [17][43].

- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › 原文未解的問題
- 來源是 PowerPoint 轉成 markdown 的 lossy derivative；圖片、圖表位置、產品照片與部分連線圖細節可能遺失。
- 正式發布日期只可確認 MWC 2025 語境；簡報版次、作者與文件代碼未標示。
- `COMPANY RESTRICTED` 標示代表使用時需注意資料分類；本 ingest 只保留來源內容，不推論可公開散布範圍。
- `All 38.141 measurements supported` 是簡報層級 solution claim，未提供完整 test case matrix、option code、release version、calibration accessories 或正式 compliance statement。
- [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] 的 RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、QDART validation、parallel DUT testing 與 path correction 為簡報說法，仍需 datasheet 或 production test 文件補證。
- [[O-RU testing]] 的 O-RAN WG4 Conformance Specifications 未標示版本、profile、test case IDs、certification authority 或 option code。
- [[ETSI ES 202 706-1]] energy efficiency testing 未標示版本與適用 O-RU / base station 類型。
- 早期 6G 研究的 4 GHz / 8 GHz bandwidth、4096QAM / generic OFDM analysis 未指定產品型號、測試條件、頻段或標準版本。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › OTA conformance 與 chamber solutions
- Slide 8 把 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 與 [[R&S PWC200]] 列為 OTA testing solutions；ATS1800C 是 FR2 compact test system with high-quality quiet zone，PWC200 是 mid-band Massive MIMO device verification / plane wave converter。
- Slide 8 說 [[R&S PWC200]] 可在近場距離做 far-field measurements，例如 3.5 GHz、1 m aperture 的 5G massive MIMO base station 可在 1.5 m 做 OTA testing，而 direct far-field measurement 需要 23.5 m。
- Slide 9 說 `All 38.141 measurements supported`，並指向 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、5G NR Base Station Transmitter / Receiver / Performance Tests、Signal Generator built-in presets 與 5G NR Test Case Wizard。
- Slide 11 標題為 `5G NR base Station Conformance Testing (R&D) From Conducted to OTA testing`。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

5G NR OTA Base Station Transmitter Tests › R&S OTA test solutions
依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- [[R&S TS8991]] with WPTC：FR1、FR2。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]]：CATR based 5G NR mmWave test chamber，適合 FR2。
- [[R&S PWC200]]：Plane Wave Converter，適合 FR1 OTA massive MIMO base station testing。

可用 signal and spectrum analyzers：

- [[R&S FSW]]。
- R&S FSV / FSVA。
- R&S FSV3000 / FSVA3000。
- R&S FPS。

需要 5G NR downlink measurements software option：R&S FSW-/FSV-/FSV3-/FPS-K144。

Intermodulation test case 6.8 的 interfering signal 可由配備 -K144 的 [[R&S SMW200A]] 或 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 產生；來源也說這兩款 vector signal generator 可作為 demonstration purposes 模擬 5G NR base station。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › R&S SMW200A key features

- FRCs。
- TMs。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。
